cohort: 2145 women from five different hospitals in Norway
finding: While there were no differences in the occurrence of fear of birth between five Norwegian hospitals, counselling methods, resources, and the number of women who received counselling varied, and both primiparous and multiparous women who reported fear of birth had a twofold increased risk of a planned cesarean section.
mod_finding: Both primi- and multiparous women who reported fear of birth had a twofold increased risk of a planned caesarean section.
